fields.name: Path of the Inner Eye
fields.desc: The barbarians who follow the Inner Eye elevate their rage beyond anger to glimpse premonitions of the future.

fields.name: Path of the Souleater
fields.desc: Spreading from a fringe sect among a minotaur order, souleaters deliberately infect themselves with a non-contagious variant of the ravening. These barbarians consume souls to gain the power of their foes.

fields.name: College of the Cat
fields.desc: Scholars and spies, heroes and hunters: whether wooing an admirer in the bright sunlight or stalking prey under the gentle rays of the moon, bards of the College of the Cat excel at diverse skills and exhibit contrary tendencies, not unlike their feline patron.

fields.name: College of the Sky
fields.desc: The aeromancers of a flying city use their magic to keep the city afloat. Bards of the College of the Sky are proficient with the magic of the element of air, acting as the face of the city's power.

fields.name: Cat Domain
fields.desc: You embody the grace, strength, and resilience of felines. Eventually, you gain the ability to take the form of a lion or a tiger.

fields.name: Wasteland Strider
fields.desc: Wasteland Striders are rangers who have adapted to survive in the harshest desert environments, becoming one with the endless sands.
